CustomField.formula: (IF(ISBLANK(Prod_Max_End_Date__c),SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c,(YEAR(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ) - YEAR( Prod_Min_Start_Date__c))*12 - MONTH(Prod_Min_Start_Date__c) + MONTH(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ) + ((DAY(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ) - DAY(Prod_Min_Start_Date__c) + 1) / CASE(MONTH(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ), 4,30, 6,30, 9,30, 11,30, 2, IF(OR( MOD( YEAR(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ), 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( YEAR(Prod_Max_End_Date__c ), 4 ) = 0, MOD( YEAR( Prod_Max_End_Date__c ), 100 ) != 0 ) ),29,28), 31))))
